decisions.reason: Submarine interior lighting is distant from the core building and industrial lighting portfolio and lacks strong presence, making discontinuation likely.
Explosion-proof luminaires build on established industrial lighting expertise and remain strategically relevant.
Designer task light is close to the core offering and continues to serve professional workspaces.
Pendant office luminaire is a core professional building lighting product with a recent launch.
Premium pendant luminaire targets a profitable professional segment aligned with the firm's strengths.
